title: Smart Controller Upgrade — PJL Land Services

hero.sub: A complete upgrade to the Hunter Hydrawise smart controller for {{propertyAddress}} — everything below is included in the single price at the end. Review it on your own time and sign online when you're ready.

why.heading: Why upgrade to Hydrawise
why.lead: Your current controller runs on a fixed timer — it waters on its schedule whether it rained yesterday, is raining right now, or a heat wave is coming. Hydrawise replaces that guesswork with watering that reads the weather.

cards.title: Predictive Watering
cards.body: Hydrawise pulls real-time local weather and adjusts automatically — skipping runs when rain is forecast, throttling back on cool days, and running longer through hot stretches.

cards.title: Retires the rain sensor
cards.body: It does the job a manual rain sensor was supposed to do — better, and without the maintenance. If your rain sensor is aging or already dead, there's nothing to replace: the upgrade retires it entirely.

cards.title: The app in your pocket
cards.body: Start, stop, or override any zone from anywhere. See zone-by-zone runtime history, and get alerts when something's wrong — a wiring fault, a missed run, or a controller that dropped offline.

cards.title: We watch it too
cards.body: PJL can monitor your system remotely, which often means we catch a problem before you see it on the lawn.

hardware.heading: The hardware in this upgrade
hardware.lead: Real equipment, professionally installed — here's what goes on the wall and in the ground.

items.title: Hunter HCC Wi-Fi controller
items.body: The Wi-Fi brain of the system, sized to your zone count with the right expansion module(s).

items.title: Flow & leak monitoring
items.body: A Hydrawise flow meter watches real water use zone-by-zone — so a broken line or a stuck valve triggers an alert instead of a surprise on your water bill.

items.title: Wireless valves
items.body: Valves that talk to the controller without new control wire run across the yard — cleaner installs and easy future expansion.

items.title: The Hydrawise app
items.body: Your whole system on your phone — zone photos, runtime history, water-savings reports, and control from anywhere.

included.heading: What's included in your install
included.lead: One visit, typically about two hours start to finish.
includes: Hunter HCC Hydrawise Wi-Fi controller, sized to your system with the right expansion module(s)
Removal of your existing controller and a clean swap-over of all zone wiring
Wi-Fi connection and Hydrawise app setup on your phone
Full seasonal schedule programmed for your zones and plantings
A hands-on walkthrough so you're comfortable with the app before we leave
excludes: Hydrawise retrofits onto most residential systems regardless of the original brand — Hunter, Rain Bird, Toro, Orbit, Irritrol, or builder-grade.
Larger panels are quoted separately after a site assessment.

savings.kicker: Weather-aware watering typically cuts seasonal use by 30–40%
savings.sub: is what the upgrade can save on a standard 6-zone lot — it pays for itself, then keeps saving every season after. See how your own numbers land at pjllandservices.com/water-cost-calculator.html.

investment.heading: Your investment
investment.priceBody: Everything above — controller, expansion modules, flow meter, wireless valves, the swap-over, Wi-Fi and app setup, seasonal programming, and the walkthrough — in one price.
investment.warrantyBody: If the controller or our installation gives you trouble, we make it right at no charge.
investment.credBody: Patrick is Hunter Hydrawise Certified — trained directly by Hunter Industries on smart-controller programming, hydraulic design, and water-efficient zone configuration — and PJL is a Hunter Authorized Installer. The same Hydrawise controllers we install for customers run on our own systems.

close.heading: Ready when you are
close.body: Review it on your own time — when the upgrade looks right, sign online and we'll book your install.
